description:
investigate and decompose goal: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts, record whether a compose was operator-directed in both of the artifacts it writes, so reach can be split by goal author without correlating against git log.

WHY. goal-host sets `directed: opts.operatorOrigin === true` on the operator/edit-intent route, and feature-compose already computes that value and prints it to the console at the "[compose]" log line. It writes it to NEITHER the compose report JSON NOR the trace metadata. Because it is absent, nothing downstream can tell an operator-authored compose from an autonomous one: reach_rate_scan reports a single blended feature_compose reach_rate of 6/313 and mints a gap blaming the compose activity, when operator-authored and autonomous composes on identical machinery differ by more than an order of magnitude. The trace metadata already carries the sibling distinction `route: "escalation" | "gated"`, and the comment beside it records that authorship has been misattributed twice before and cost a manual bisect over commit trailers and gap-id prefixes. This adds the missing field to both writers.

THE CHANGE. Exactly two ops, both in this one file.

OP 1 — the compose report. Find this text, which occurs exactly once:

verdict, spec: String(spec).slice(0, 8000)

Replace it with exactly:

verdict, directed: (pointer as { directed?: boolean }).directed === true, spec: String(spec).slice(0, 8000)

OP 2 — the trace metadata. Find this line, which occurs exactly once:

          route: String(pointer.gap?.id ?? "").startsWith("pwt-") ? "escalation" : "gated",

Replace it with exactly these two lines:

          route: String(pointer.gap?.id ?? "").startsWith("pwt-") ? "escalation" : "gated",
          directed: (pointer as { directed?: boolean }).directed === true,

SCOPE. Do not rename anything, do not widen FeatureComposePointer, and do not change the console log line. The local cast `(pointer as { directed?: boolean })` is the same one already used twice in this file, deliberately, because the shared pointer type does not declare the field and widening it is a separate change.
